title: Free 2 + MiaoMiao 1 + Xdrip
symptom: The user cannot get the combination of FreeStyle Libre 2, MiaoMiao 1, and xDrip to work. xDrip does not show any readings (BG Readings Unavailable) even though System Status seems correct. The log shows 'got null pointer trying to set cccd descriptor' and sometimes data is received but connection cuts off.
cause: The thread does not definitively establish a root cause, but a user found that disabling OOPAlgorithm processing in xDrip settings made it work, suggesting that the OOPAlgorithm processing setting may interfere.
fix: A working combination was found: MM1 fw39, xDrip 2021.01.05, OOPAlgorithm 2, and the trick is to DISABLE OOPAlgorithm processing in xDrip settings. This was confirmed by a user and acknowledged by a maintainer.
evidence_quote: And the trick is to **DISABLE OOPAlgorithm processing in xDrip settings.** Not sure why and it does not make sense, but it works this way and OOPAlgorithm is still called in logs.
